principles.name: Section toolbar and title
principles.requirement: Every panel section starts with a toolbar containing a section title (with SVG icon), optional helper text, and section view controls when multiple presentation modes exist.

principles.name: Multi-mode presentation
principles.requirement: Data sections support switching presentation modes (cards, table, list, matrix, …) without a full page reload. View-switch contains presentation modes only.

principles.name: Create via primary Add button
principles.requirement: Preferred identities-style layout: a primary Add/create button sits to the LEFT of .item-view-switch on the same toolbar row (.section-view-toolbar). The view-switch MUST NOT include add/import/create/register as a mode. Clicking Add opens the create form and sets the same URL view param (view=add|import|…). Do not keep a duplicate create mode inside the switch. Do not duplicate a leading '+' character when an SVG plus icon is already present. Legacy create-last-in-switch is superseded by this layout.

principles.name: Device-aware default view
principles.requirement: When the URL has no explicit view= (and the user has not pinned a view in session storage), auto-select a presentation mode from breakpoints: desktop → table; small tablet or portrait/pivot orientation → list; small mobile/smartphone → panels (alias of cards). Explicit view= always wins. Optional session/local pin must not override an explicit URL. view=panels is accepted as an alias for cards.

principles.name: Full-width section controls
principles.requirement: The Add + view-switch row (.section-view-toolbar) stretches across the section width so controls read as one bar (flex stretch), not a cramped inline-only cluster.

principles.name: Newest first
principles.requirement: Creating a resource prepends it to the collection [new, ...prev].

principles.name: Lazy loading
principles.requirement: Production collections use a unified infinite-scroll (or equivalent) footer to load further pages.

principles.name: URL state sync
principles.requirement: Panel state is shareable via history.replaceState without full reload. Canonical params: tab, view, nested selection ids (project/host/org/…), registry, tag, filter.

principles.name: Org → project → artifacts
principles.requirement: When projects exist, present org filter, project list, then project detail with tickets/artifacts. IA order preference: system chat → account → integrations → … → projects → organization registers.

principles.name: Domain tabs vs presentation views
principles.requirement: Top-nav tab (URL tab=) identifies one content domain. View-switch (URL view=) changes presentation or create mode only (cards|table|list|matrix|kanban|agenda|…|add|import). Unrelated domains MUST NOT share one tab behind fake view modes — split into separate tabs (e.g. integrations vs mcp vs a2a) or use nested filters (registry=, tag=, filter=, org=).

principles.name: Connector registry filters
principles.requirement: MCP and A2A are separate top-level tabs (or a dedicated connectors tab with registry=mcp|a2a). Each uses presentation view-switch plus tag/text filters. Register via the primary Add button (not as a view-switch domain mode). New entries prepend. Do not nest MCP/A2A inside the API integrations catalogue tab.

principles.name: System chat surface
principles.requirement: When a system chat surface exists (e.g. OpenWebUI), durable URL configuration is account/hosting + server-side injection (env / PHP window global). Browser-only localStorage is optional override, never the sole persistence. Unavailable services fail gracefully.

principles.name: Inline SVG icons
principles.requirement: Navigation and action icons use inline SVG components. Unicode/emoji as control icons are forbidden.

params.registry: Domain filter under a tab (organization: clients|contacts|contracts|support; connectors legacy: mcp|a2a when not top-level tabs)

required_assertions: Without view= URL, device default selects table|list|cards/panels
URL reflects tab and view without reload
Infinite-scroll footer present on production collections
